literature.abstract: Epileptic diathesis is an inherited neurophysiological trait that contributes to the development of all types of epilepsy. Voltage-dependent Ca2+ channels, integral membrane proteins that permit extracellular Ca2+ to enter cells down their electrical and concentration gradients, have a universal role in stimulus-response coupling in excitable cells. literature.title: Cinnarizine is a useful and well-tolerated drug in the treatment of acquired cold urticaria (ACU).
literature.abstract: Old generation H1-type antihistamines are the standard therapeutic option for acquired cold urticaria (ACU), but adverse effects are common. New antihistamines are well tolerated but efficacy is often poor. The present study aims to evaluate efficacy and safety of cinnarizine in the treatment of ACU patients intolerant to old antihistamines and resistant to new drugs. repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: ⚠️ 文獻誤對應警示：PMID 12609783 研究的是「acquired cold urticaria（獲得性冷接觸性蕁麻疹）」而非「common cold（普通感冒）」，兩者為完全不同疾病。冷蕁麻疹是溫度觸發的過敏反應，Cinnarizine 的 H1 拮抗可緩解症狀；普通感冒為病毒性感染，Cinnarizine 無抗病毒機轉。TxGNN 可能出現疾病名稱混淆，此適應症應視為 L5。
蟲蝕狀皮膚萎縮（Atrophoderma vermiculata）為罕見毛孔角化症，病因涉及毛囊漏斗部異常角化，與 Cinnarizine 的鈣通道阻斷或 H1 拮抗機轉無已知關聯。無任何文獻或試驗支持，TxGNN 預測可能來自皮膚科疾病節點的圖譜近鄰效應。

literature.title: Effects of phenobarbitone, cinnarizine, and zoxazolamine on the development of right ventricular hypertrophy and hypertensive pulmonary vascular disease in rats treated with monocrotaline.
literature.abstract: The results of this experiment suggest that the addition of zoxazolamine to the diet may prolong the survival and reduce the incidence of right ventricular hypertrophy and hypertensive pulmonary vascular disease in male rats given a single subcutaneous injection of monocrotaline. Phenobarbitone and cinnarizine were ineffective.

repurposing_rationale.mechanistic_link: 肺動脈高壓的病生理涉及肺血管平滑肌增生與收縮，Cinnarizine 的鈣通道阻斷在理論上可降低肺血管阻力（與 nifedipine 類似機轉），但現有文獻均為 1976-1988 年的早期研究，方法學不足。現代 PAH 治療已有更專一的靶向藥物（ERA、PDE5i、sGC agonist），Cinnarizine 的競爭力有限。
眉部毛周角化（Ulerythema ophryogenesis）為罕見遺傳性毛囊角化症，病因涉及毛囊角化異常，與 Cinnarizine 藥理機轉（鈣通道阻斷、H1 拮抗）無已知關聯。無任何支持文獻或試驗，TxGNN 預測可能來自與 atrophoderma vermiculata 相似的皮膚疾病圖譜近鄰效應，預測可靠性低。
